summary: Both r1 findings are genuinely resolved: the commit-less bypass at Jenkinsfile.iac-image:37-39 keeps the version poller's weekly rebuild building (premise re-verified live — the iac:latest labels still name this job with rebuild-at 2026-08-19 and no params), and the Jenkinsfile is now its own watched input, with everything else byte-identical. Three findings remain, all tagged advisory and none demanding a fix round: one Major — the fix infers 'the poller triggered' from an empty changeset, so a poller build that absorbs un-changelogged commits is still skipped and, per poller.py:165-176 and :157-164, lost permanently — plus the comment's claim that a commit-less build is always the poller's (job history #117 is a manual build with no changeset, which now force-rebuilds) and the absence of any acceptance criterion covering the new branch.
